text_block_list.text:
When I came to the cafeteria,
I spotted King Halo groaning about something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kh... I can't afford to gain
any more weight.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To maintain my first-rate beauty,
I'll have to refrain from sweets for a while...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
Um... I was just thinking about dietary restrictions.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look, physique is important for Umamusume too, right?
For example...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In races, powerful yet supple.In Winning Lives, elegant and light.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I believe that to be first-rate, one must captivate the audience with both running and dancing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So make sure you do your part
and support her to the fullest as her Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying me on early morning runs,
calculating my calories for me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So King can stay first-class in beauty too, you have to strictly manage yourself every day!

"—Afterward, I helped King Halo
with her routine to maintain her ideal figure."
